The Thousand Tales of [[Anla the Wise Counselor]] is one of the fables that [[Thom]] hints at performing as he is waiting for a larger crowd outside of [[The Winespring Inn]].{{ref/book|1|4}}

== Parallels ==
The Thousand Tales of Anla the Wise Counselor is likely a reference to the long running Ann Landers advice column.[[Category:Legends]]
